topPRs.title: feat(pcd): Add Predictive Chain Deployments design doc
topPRs.author: 0xiamflux
topPRs.body:
## Purpose

Eliminate the ~7-day permissioned window every new OP Stack chain currently incurs before its permissionless dispute game can activate. The window is a deployment tooling artifact, and this document specifies the tooling redesign that removes it.

## Summary

New OP Stack chains today launch under a permissioned dispute game for roughly a week. The deployment pipeline can't seed the L1 dispute system with a real anchor at deploy time, because the L2 genesis depends on L1 contract addresses and the L1 dispute system needs the resulting output root, and today's tooling can't satisfy both at once. It ships placeholder values and defers permissionless proofs until a real dispute resolves a week later.

This design closes the gap by deriving everything off-chain before any transaction lands. `op-deployer` predicts the L1 contract addresses, builds the L2 genesis state and its output root, drives the prestate build, and finally submits `OPCM.deploy()` with the real values. The dispute system is seeded atomically with L1 contract deployment, and the permissionless game is valid from L2 block 0. No on-chain contract logic changes, the work lives entirely in tooling orchestration.

topPRs.title: feat: Add FMA for Super ZK Dispute Game
topPRs.author: 0xarktos
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Extends the existing ZK Dispute Game failure mode analysis to cover the `SuperZKDisputeGame`, the ZK-proof variant adapted for the interop superchain that commits to a super root over all chains rather than a single-chain output root.

### Changes

- **Updated existing FMs (FM1–FM9)** for the superchain context: aggregation circuit covering all chains, multi-chain monitoring surface, variable-length `extraData`, full-superchain proving costs.
- **Added FM10**: Anchor State Type Mismatch on First Super Game (migration risk).
- **Added FM11**: Partial Chain Monitoring Allows Fraudulent Output Root to Stand.
- **Added FM12**: Shared Parameter Drift as Superchain Scales (operational counterpart to FM7, triggered by chain set evolution).
- **Merged** the old FM6 (CWIA encoding mismatch) and a draft FM10 (variable extraData offset corruption) into a single FM6 covering the full encode / decode / validate chain.
- **Merged** the old FM5 (Prestate Mismatch) with a draft FM13 (Chain Set or STF Change) into a single FM5 with three root-cause sub-cases.
- Replaced all undefined abbreviations (`SZKDG`, `SFDG`, `SPDG`, `ASR`) with their full contract names and defined `VKey`, `STF`, `CWIA`, `TVL` on first use.
- Updated audit requirements and the consolidated Action Items table.

For an easier to view diff see [here](https://www.diffchecker.com/KRt1hsip/)

- TODO: Update spec references once the `SuperZKDisputeGame` spec gets merged.
